name: ai.appgoat/mcp
title: AppGoat
description: App Store and Google Play data: apps, reviews, keywords, charts, competitors, ASO playbooks.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Look up one App Store or Google Play app: title, subtitle, developer, category, price, rating and histogram, installs (Play), version and dates, description, languages, and the same app in the other store. Accepts any id, bundle id, package, store URL or a name. Reads stored data (refreshed from the store only when older than max_age, default 7 days) for one country (default us); add include sections for markets, versions, IAP, privacy, estimates and chart positions. Cost: 1 + 1 per country refreshed from the store (max 10) credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

country.description: ISO country code(s): `us` (default), a comma list (paid plans), or `all` (Studio). Example: us,de

max_age.description: Refresh from the store when our data is older than this many seconds (0 = always). Default 604800 (7 days).

wait.description: Block up to ~25 s for a refresh (default). false = answer immediately from cache with a job id.

include.description: Extra sections: markets (every storefront), iap, versions (history with release notes), privacy (App Store labels), estimates (modelled downloads/revenue), charts (current top-chart positions)

full_text.description: Return long text (description, release notes, review bodies) in full instead of cut short

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Read an app's user reviews, newest first, up to 100 per page: rating, title, text, version, date, developer reply and AI tags (sentiment, intent, severity, topic) where tagged. Filter by stars (rating='1-2' for complaints), version, date range, text (q) or AI tags (intent='bug,crash'; tag filters skip untagged reviews). Page with cursor. Cost: 1 per page + 1 if the US reviews are refreshed credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

topic.description: AI topic filter (comma list of topic labels, case-insensitive, or topic ids).

max_age.description: Refresh the latest US reviews when older than this many seconds. Default 86400 (1 day).

full_text.description: Return long text (description, release notes, review bodies) in full instead of cut short

tools.description: A top free, paid or grossing chart for a store, country and category, today or on a past date: rank, app, developer, rating and the move since the previous capture (new entries marked), plus apps that dropped out. Charts are captured daily for every country and category. Cost: 1 credits.

tools.name: keyword_research
tools.description: Keyword metrics and research for App Store / Google Play search terms: popularity (5–100), difficulty (0–100), result count and the #1 result's estimated daily downloads. include adds related terms with metrics, the store's autocomplete and the current top 10 apps; app adds that app's rank and metadata relevance per term (the core of an ASO keyword audit). Unmeasured terms are measured live (a few per call) or come back pending. Keyword ideas: pass only app (no terms) to get the terms worth targeting for that app, best opportunity first: AI-checked for relevance (other apps' brand names and off-topic terms dropped), scored from popularity, difficulty and the app's rank, each with a reason. A new app's first call queues the research (a few minutes, not charged). Cost: 1 per keyword; 5 per seed with include=related or suggestions; 5 for keyword ideas (0 while pending) credits.

terms.description: Search terms, 1–25 (at most 5 with include related or suggestions). Omit, with app, for keyword ideas for that app

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (storefront), e.g. us, gb, de. Default: us.

app.description: Any app identifier (as in `{app}`); adds `app.rank` and `app.relevance` per term. Alone (no `q` / `qs`) it returns keyword ideas for the app.

wait.description: Block up to ~25 s for a refresh (default). false = answer immediately from cache with a job id.

include.description: related (~10 related terms with metrics), suggestions (store autocomplete), top_apps (current top 10). related/suggestions cost 5 credits per term

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

id.description: Keyword slot id (from a keyword watch)

app.description: Store app id; returns `rank` per point instead of the full id list.

from.description: Start, ISO date or datetime (default 90 days ago)

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Watch an app, a set of competitors or a set of keywords; significant changes become events (get_events, webhooks, daily email). kind app {app}: new versions, metadata and price changes, featuring, rating drops, review and ratings spikes, chart entries. kind competitor_set {competitors, app?}: the same for every competitor. kind keyword {terms, store or app}: the app's rank moves per term and new apps in the top N. Watched apps count against the plan's watch limit, keyword watches use one keyword slot per term × store × country; over a limit nothing changes (plan_limit). With id, changes that watch instead (send only what changes; settings are merged; active=false pauses it). Cost: 0 credits.

id.description: Watch id to change (from list_watches). Omit to create a watch

kind.description: 'app' (one app), 'competitor_set' (several apps) or 'keyword' (search terms). Required when creating

app.description: Any app id, bundle id, package, store URL or name. kind app: the app (required); competitor_set: your own app (optional); keyword: the app whose ranks to report (optional)

competitors.description: kind competitor_set: the apps to watch (any identifiers), up to 50

terms.description: kind keyword: search terms, e.g. ['habit tracker', 'streaks']

store.description: 'apple', 'play' or 'both' (keyword watches without app; default both). Also disambiguates app inputs

countries.description: Two-letter country codes to watch in (default ['us'])

event_types.description: Only these event types (default: every type of the kind)

settings.description: Thresholds: significance (0–1, default 0.5, minimum for an event), rank_move (default 5), keyword_top_n (10), chart_top_n (100), rating_drop (stars over 7 days, 0.1), spike_factor (3), email_digest (true), depth and cadence_minutes (keyword watches)

significance.description: Minimum significance for an event: Jev's probability that an analyst would want the alert (AI on), or a fixed per-type score. Default: 0.5.

email_digest.description: Include in the daily email digest. Default: true.

depth.description: Keyword watches: results kept per ranking (Apple ≤ 250, Play ≤ 30).

active.description: false pauses the watch, true resumes it

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

tools.name: unwatch
tools.description: Stop watches by id (from list_watches or watch): no new events, and their watched apps and keyword slots are freed. Past events are kept. To pause instead, call watch with id and active=false. Cost: 0 credits.

tools.name: read_connection
tools.description: Read live data from one of the user's connected accounts. what='reviews' (asc, play_console): the app's own reviews with reply status, unanswered=true for those without a developer reply; their review_id feeds propose_action review.reply (Play only returns reviews from the last 7 days). what='listing' (asc, play_console): the current listing text for one locale with lengths and which fields are editable right now (App Store name, subtitle, description, keywords and what's new need a version in Prepare for Submission). what='ads' (apple_ads): view=campaigns → ad_groups (campaign_id) → keywords (campaign_id, ad_group_id) gives the ids the apple_ads.* actions take, view=negatives lists negative keywords, view=report with level=campaigns|adgroups|keywords|searchterms returns impressions, taps, installs, spend, CPT and CPA for start..end (default the last 7 days; granularity=DAILY adds a per-day series, up to 90 days), view=suggestions (app, optional terms and countries) returns Apple's keyword suggestions for a linked app with relative popularity, view=popularity (terms, countries) returns Apple's own search popularity per term for the last finished week. Cost: 1 credits.

app.description: A linked app (App Store id or package name); required for reviews, listing and ads view=suggestions

unanswered.description: reviews: only reviews without a developer reply

country.description: reviews: App Store territory filter (two-letter code)

locale.description: listing: locale such as en-US, de-DE (default en-US)

campaign_id.description: ads: campaign id (needed for ad_groups, keywords, negatives and every report level except campaigns)

ad_group_id.description: ads: ad group id (needed for keywords; optional for negatives)

start.description: ads report: start date YYYY-MM-DD (default 7 days before end)

end.description: ads report: end date YYYY-MM-DD (default yesterday, UTC)

granularity.description: ads report: add a series per row (DAILY ≤ 90 days, WEEKLY ≥ 14 days, MONTHLY ≥ 90 days)

terms.description: ads suggestions (seed terms) / popularity (required): up to 100 search terms, list or 'a,b'

countries.description: ads suggestions / popularity: two-letter country codes (popularity default us)

limit.description: Max rows: reviews up to 200 (default 100), ads up to 1000 (default 200)

cursor.description: reviews: next_cursor from the previous page

full_text.description: Return long text (description, release notes, review bodies) in full instead of cut short

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Prepare a change to the user's connected account as a DRY RUN: nothing is written. AppGoat reads the live account and returns the before → after diff, guardrail results (AI probabilities for store policy, tone and risky claims, plus checks such as character limits and bid jumps) and an action id. ALWAYS show the diff and any guardrail flags to the user and get their go-ahead before calling apply_action. Types and params (app = a linked App Store id or package name, locale like en-US): review.reply {app, review_id, text} (review ids from read_connection what=reviews; Play replies ≤ 350 chars); listing.update {app, locale, fields: {name|title, subtitle, description, promotional_text, whats_new, marketing_url, support_url, privacy_policy_url}} (Play: title, short_description, full_description, video); keywords.set {app, locale, keywords: [..] or 'a,b,c', mode?: replace|add|remove} (App Store, 100 bytes comma-joined); screenshots.upload {app, locale, display_type: APP_IPHONE_67… (asc) or image_type: phoneScreenshots… (play), images: [{url}], replace?}; apple_ads.keyword.bid {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{id, bid?, status?: ENABLED|PAUSED}], max_increase?}; apple_ads.keyword.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{text, match_type?: EXACT|BROAD, bid?}]}; apple_ads.negative.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id?, keywords: [{text, match_type?}]}; apple_ads.campaign.create {app, name, countries: ['US'], daily_budget, placement?: APPSTORE_SEARCH_RESULTS (default)|APPSTORE_SEARCH_TAB|APPSTORE_TODAY_TAB|APPSTORE_PRODUCT_PAGES, max_daily_budget?} (manual CPT in the ad account currency; always created PAUSED); apple_ads.campaign.update {campaign_id, status?: ENABLED|PAUSED, daily_budget?, countries?, name?}; apple_ads.adgroup.create {campaign_id, name, default_bid, search_match?: false, status?, start_time?}; apple_ads.adgroup.update {campaign_id, ad_group_id, status?, default_bid?, search_match?, name?} (Apple Ads ids from read_connection what=ads). Apple Ads changes that can raise spend (enabling a campaign or ad group, a higher budget or default bid, new countries, Search Match on) are marked 'can raise ad spend': apply them only on the user's explicit go-ahead. Cost: 0 credits.

type.description: What to change: review.reply, listing.update, keywords.set, screenshots.upload, apple_ads.keyword.bid, apple_ads.keyword.add, apple_ads.negative.add, apple_ads.campaign.create, apple_ads.campaign.update, apple_ads.adgroup.create or apple_ads.adgroup.update

params.description: Params for the type (see the tool description)

connection.description: Connection id from list_connections; optional when exactly one active connection fits the type and app

playbook.description: The playbook proposing this, e.g. 'reply-to-every-review' (shown to approvers); omit outside a playbook

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

tools.name: apply_action
tools.description: Go ahead with an action from propose_action, after the user has seen its diff and agreed. Outcomes: applied (written to the store / Apple Ads account, 1 credit; when the org has an auto-apply rule the guardrail score clears, or allows agents to approve); pending_approval (a person must approve it in the AppGoat dashboard: give the user the approve link, nothing is written until then); needs a person (it was already pending and agents may not approve: hand over the link, do not retry); changed (the account changed since the dry run: the new diff is shown; show it to the user and call again with force=true only if they accept it, or propose_action again). Cost: 1 credit when applied, else 0 credits.

force.description: Apply the recomputed diff even though the account changed since the dry run. Only after the user has seen the new diff

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: One action from propose_action: its status (draft, pending_approval, approved, applied, failed, rejected), diff, guardrail scores, the provider result or error, the approve link and the audit trail. Use it to check whether a pending action was approved and applied. Cost: 0 credits.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

tools.name: reject_action
tools.description: Discard a draft or pending action the user does not want; nothing is written to the account. Cost: 0 credits.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

tools.name: audit_app
tools.description: Run an App Audit of one app in one country: a 0–100 score, prioritised ASO actions with evidence, title / subtitle / keyword rewrites within the store character limits, and findings from listing, ratings, reviews, keywords and competitors, plus a shareable report page. Takes 1–3 minutes: waits about 25 s, then returns the audit id to pass to get_audit. An audit of the same app, country and mode from the last 24 h is returned again for free unless fresh=true; failed audits are not charged. The first audit of an organization is free (free_only=true runs only that one). On the Free plan the report shows the top 3 problems and a one-line summary of the rest; fixes, actions and rewrites come back empty with `locked` and an `upgrade_url` (paid plans get the full report). Cost: 100 credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

mode.description: lite = cached data, fewer reviews and keywords (cheaper and faster for us; same price). Default: full.

fresh.description: Run again even if a recent audit exists. Default: false.

free_only.description: Only run when it is the free first audit (402 free_audit_used otherwise). Default: false.

white_label.description: Studio: the shareable report shows the organization's branding (set in the dashboard under Settings → Report branding) instead of AppGoat's, e.g. for client or prospect reports.

label.description: Your label for the audit list, e.g. the client or prospect name.

tools.name: list_playbooks
tools.description: AppGoat playbooks: step-by-step recipes (which tools to call, credit budget, decision rules, output format) for app audits, app idea research, ASO metadata rewrites, weekly competitor digests, turning reviews into GitHub issues, and, on connected accounts, replying to every review, launching and optimizing Apple Ads and pushing localized listings. Without name, lists them; with name, returns the full playbook to follow. Also offered as MCP prompts. Free.

name.description: A playbook name from the list, e.g. 'app-audit-lite'
